Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 14
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 14, the Planner incorrectly stated in its analysis that the Budd Boetticher Wikipedia page shows a birth year of 1906 ("The task is to determine which director was born later... Past messages show conflicting birth years for Budd Boetticher (1906 vs. 1916)..."). However, the WebSurfer's result in the immediately preceding step (Step 13) clearly displayed the Wikipedia page stating "Born Oscar Boetticher Jr. July 29, 1916". The Planner hallucinated the year 1906, contradicting the verified evidence it had just reviewed, leading to a false conclusion that Don Barry (born 1910) was born later than Boetticher (incorrectly cited as 1906).
